title: debt-rate-hedge
description: RFC 0056 / format 4.7. Shape only. The rate_type gate (HDG-03), the rate_cap_pct agreement (HDG-04) and the rate_cap_cost agreement (HDG-05) are semantic checks. rate_swap and rate_collar are reserved by HDG-02 and are deliberately absent from the instrument enum.

notional.description: What the cap is written on. A loan larger than this is partly unhedged.

strike_rate.description: A fraction, not a percent. 0.035 is 3.5%.

index.description: The rate_index vocabulary minus `fixed`, which a cap is not struck against.

premium.description: Upfront cash paid. null means genuinely none. Never priced from a curve.

post_expiration_assumption.description: What happens in the month after the cap expires. No default: unstated is the answer that hides the cliff.

counterparty.description: Author narrative. Nothing is inferred from it.
